dataset_name: ResuMate Structure Score Rubric Regression Set
provenance: All resume text and parser-profile fixtures in this file are fictional and written for this project. No real resumes or candidate data are included.
limitations: Expected scores are calculated from the same explicit rubric implemented in resume_service.py. This set checks rubric consistency and regressions only; it does not establish agreement with ATS software, recruiters, hiring outcomes, or resume quality in general.
